import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        return a >= MOD ? a - MOD : a;
    }

    static int sub(int a, int b) {
        return a >= b ? a - b : a + MOD - b;
    }

    static long mul(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static int modPow(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (int) mul(res, base);
            base = (int) mul(base, base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int n;
    static int[][] prob = new int[8][8];
    static int[][] match = new int[8][8];
    static int[][][] tripleMask = new int[7][7][7];
    static int fullMask;
    static int[] dp = new int[1048576];
    static int finalAnswer;

    static boolean isValid(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] values = {0, x, y, z};
        int[] indices = {0, 1, 2, 3};
        do {
            boolean ok = true;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; ++i) {
                if (match[indices[i]][values[i]] == 0) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (ok) return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(indices, 1, 3));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        int i = end;
        while (i > start && array[i - 1] >= array[i]) i--;
        if (i <= start) return false;
        
        int j = end;
        while (array[j] <= array[i - 1]) j--;
        
        int temp = array[i - 1];
        array[i - 1] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        
        j = end;
        while (i < j) {
            temp = array[i];
            array[i] = array[j];
            array[j] = temp;
            i++;
            j--;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void forwardSearch(int current, int row, int col) {
        if (current == 0) return;
        if (row == 4) {
            boolean[] used = {false, true, true, true, true, true, true};
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (isValid(i, j, k)) {
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = false;
                            int a = -1, b = -1, c = -1;
                            for (int l = 1; l <= 6; ++l) {
                                if (!used[l]) {
                                    if (a == -1) a = l;
                                    else if (b == -1) b = l;
                                    else c = l;
                                }
                            }
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = true;
                            if (c != -1) state |= tripleMask[a][b][c];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            dp[state] = add(dp[state], current);
            return;
        }
        match[row][col] = 1;
        int nextVal = (int) mul(current, prob[row][col]);
        if (col == 6) forwardSearch(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else forwardSearch(nextVal, row, col + 1);
        match[row][col] = 0;
        nextVal = (int) mul(current, sub(1, prob[row][col]));
        if (col == 6) forwardSearch(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else forwardSearch(nextVal, row, col + 1);
    }

    static void backwardSearch(int current, int row, int col) {
        if (current == 0) return;
        if (row == 7) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                        if (isValid(i, j, k)) state |= tripleMask[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            finalAnswer = add(finalAnswer, (int) mul(current, dp[fullMask ^ state]));
            return;
        }
        match[row - 3][col] = 1;
        int nextVal = (int) mul(current, prob[row][col]);
        if (col == 6) backwardSearch(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else backwardSearch(nextVal, row, col + 1);
        match[row - 3][col] = 0;
        nextVal = (int) mul(current, sub(1, prob[row][col]));
        if (col == 6) backwardSearch(nextVal, row + 1, 1);
        else backwardSearch(nextVal, row, col + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                int x = sc.nextInt();
                prob[i][j] = (int) mul(x, inv100);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; ++i) prob[i][i] = 1;
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k) {
                    tripleMask[i][j][k] = 1 << count;
                    ++count;
                }
            }
        }
        fullMask = (1 << count) - 1;
        forwardSearch(1, 1, 1);
        int totalMasks = 1 << count;
        for (int bit = 0; bit < count; ++bit) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; ++mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                    dp[mask] = add(dp[mask], dp[mask ^ (1 << bit)]);
                }
            }
        }
        finalAnswer = 0;
        backwardSearch(1, 4, 1);
        finalAnswer = sub(1, finalAnswer);
        System.out.println(finalAnswer);
    }
}
